title: Family of man
brief_description: A portrayal of the “Family of Man” exhibit on display in the US in 1955 and in Australia in which Edward Steichen describes and demonstrates various exhibit panels, and explains how photography can be used as an art medium to show the universal oneness and goodness of mankind.
